title: Custom discs but Loco-like
description: Are you tired of just a few discs? Well because now you have some new jukebox items (with one aviable only in creative) to use for having cool music! Each disc has more songs on it, everytime you reput the disc into the jukebox, you get a new song!
body:
Are you tired of just a few discs? Well because now you have some new jukebox items (with one aviable only in creative) to use for having cool music! Each disc has more songs on it, everytime you reput the disc into the jukebox, you get a new song!

 Main informations
-  There are lots of songs included in 4 discs (X1 only creative), like Mus_smile (Undertale (Ps4 , PsVita, Nintendo Switch, Xbox one, Xbox Series X, Xbox Series S)), The Badpiggies theme (Bad piggies (Mobile, PC)), The Metallic mario theme (Super Mario 64 (Nintendo 64)) And Much More!
- To Craft these discs you'll need :
  · One Vanilla Disc (Not every disc works)
  · The Needle, crafted using This Recipe![Needle Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/33055824dcc98022e503b9ffd71d0bd42cde5656_0.webp)
- The discs Added in 1.0.0:![1.0.0.* Discs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/83e908ce2cb1f35f240422fee56f9def13529cba.png)
  
  
 
  Have a nice day using this mod
  I  made it with all my heart so
  Enjoy!
